summary: CleanCore Solutions filed an 8-K announcing a strategic pivot to an AI critical infrastructure company, including potential divestiture of its legacy cleaning products business and wind-down of its digital-asset treasury strategy. A non-binding LOI was signed on May 7, 2026, for a Midwest data center project. CEO Tyler Hassen was appointed to the board. No specific terms (price, premium, stake) or advisors were disclosed. The transition is to occur over multiple steps, contingent on board discretion. Watch for definitive agreements, regulatory approvals, and shareholder reaction to the transformation.
